notes.title: LPTG - 2.75D Perspective Change
notes.notes:
YEA we three dimensional now B) well, more like 2.75D
LPTG V2.1.2 update:
> 3d now lol (but its really 2.75D)
> everything from 1.0.2 is gone now, we just have the closet, 94, main menu & settings
> main menu changed to barebones stuff, artists please fill in with assets :pleading_face: 
> added settings!!!! :D
> 94 model updated to be up-to-date
> music removed, will re-import later
> the hook glitch is gone you cant hook on platforms anymore
> the jumping/moon jumping is implemented to be intentional now so it cant be abused as much
> no more crouching, for now(?) might revisit later, i think we should keep it around and make it the shift key ! :D would mean more sprites for playable characters tho
> icon changed to reflect 3d state

> known bugs:
> vibrating while jumping??
> sometimes text disappears
> resolution menu duplicates resolutions for whatever reason
> the game looks bad in general
we out here or something
